title: Finite sum of squares, finite realization and noncommutative Carathéodory approximation
summary: In the noncommutative polydisc, we first prove a positive sum of squares formula for a non-negative hereditary rational nc-function. The number of summands is finite. This result is used to derive a finite-dimensional realization formula for contractive nc-rational functions, where the colligation matrix is contractive. It is unitary if and only if the function is inner.
